messages:
irene: FYI getting reports of p50 spikes on embeddings across az3-floorB since 03:20 UTC. not the dedicated tenants, looks like shared-host batch jobs causing NIC queue backlog.
sam: any packet drops on the ToR? link metrics?
kevin: ToR shows 2.3% retransmits on tor-az3b-07 and kernel logs show 'PCIe AER: Corrected error' on host-gpu-7c. suspect noisy batch jobs hitting NVLINK+NIC IO pattern.
lee: question: are these warmpool batch preloads or customer batch workloads? we need to know who to throttle.
irene: initial scan: 8 warm-preloads (warmpool) + 3 customer large-batch (non-dedicated). warm-preload tasks are highest throughput.
sam: action: mark affected hosts with label `egress_congested=true` so allocator will avoid them for new latency-sensitive allocations. patch:
```yaml
nodeAdmission:
  avoidLabels:
    - egress_congested
```
kevin: also recommend quick QoS tweak: limit warmpool pod egress to 500Mbps on those hosts via tc rule, can do without evictions. cheaper than migrating.
lee: tc + marking seems fine short-term. long-term we should consider dividing NIC lanes with SR-IOV VF carveouts for dedicated slices so shared traffic doesn't hog host egress.
irene: agree. short-term plan: 1) add label, 2) apply tc iptables egress cap to warmpool pods on host-gpu-7c/7d/7e, 3) run rebalancer to push new latency-sensitive pods away, 4) monitor for 20m. who owns the tc change?
kevin: I'll push the iproute2 tc qdisc now. will post output.
sam: double-check cost of migrating warmpool off these hosts vs egress throttling. migrating causes data movement ~1.2TB per host, cross-az if we move to eu2-edge -> expensive. throttling is cheaper but increases warmup time. decision based on SLO tradeoff.
irene: set SLO threshold: if p50 remains >200ms after 10m, escalate to migrate.
deploy-bot: ran job infra/labeler@v2: added label egress_congested=true to hosts [host-gpu-7c, host-gpu-7d, host-gpu-7e].
kevin: tc applied: `tc qdisc add dev eth0 root tbf rate 500mbit burst 32k latency 50ms` on three hosts.
(4 minutes pass)
kevin: metrics: embeddings p50 dropped from 320ms -> 86ms on affected shard. packet retransmits down to 0.8%. good.
lee: solid. follow-ups: - infra: run capacity probe to validate SR-IOV carveout feasibility (INFRA-910) - ops: add `egress_congested` to rebalancer rules for 30m sliding window (OPS-4531) - product: inform impacted customers of transient warmup slowdowns.
sam: note: tc rule could hide root PCIe error; we should still open HW ticket for PCIe AER events with datacenter ops.
irene: opened INC-2026-0316-44 for PCIe AER. kevin attach logs and nvml dumps.
lee: longer-term design note: consider 'lane reservations' in allocator so dedicated tenants can reserve 1 VF lane per GPU host to avoid noisy neighbor egress in mixed deployments. may increase fragmentation but reduces customer latency variance. put in roadmap.
irene: thanks everyone. I'll watch for 30m then clear labels if clean. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2026-0316-44 created, assigned to kevin. monitoring enabled.
